description: Pax于1957年推出的旁轴相机。配备Luminor Anastigmat 1:2.8 F=45 mm; a coated Tessar-type lens.。快门速度**Rim-set leaf shutter. 1/10 - 1/300 sec plus B. Cocked by film advance. No delayed action. Shutter-cocked indicator (red spot in window on top of lens)。使用24x36mm on 135 cartridge film.。**Coupled rangefinder under the top plate, giving double-image focusing in the viewfinder. Rangefinder baseline approx. 40 mm.。
